title: Armillary Orrery
summary: A single-file WebGL2 brass armillary orrery with crystal planets, a glowing central sun core, shadow mapping, and luminous embers.
description: A zero-asset WebGL2 3D showcase featuring engraved rotating brass armillary rings on an obsidian pedestal, orbiting crystal and metallic planets, a glowing central sun core with nested flare rings, and drifting luminous embers with HDR bloom and ACES tone mapping. Drag to orbit, wheel to zoom, aim the secondary rim light with Right Drag, Shift+Drag, L, Shift+Wheel, or R to reset, press 1–3 for lighting presets, and Space to pause.
